JetPackNative GPU Compute for Web Apps. Zero VMs.

A lightweight Rust tray orchestrator (~5–10 MB) bridging WebAssembly frontends to OS-sandboxed native & Python workers over encrypted zero-copy binary WebSockets.

Architecture

Frontend SDK
⚡

Native GPU Speed Without VMs

Executes native host binaries (PE/.exe, Mach-O, ELF) and standalone Python via uv with direct hardware access to CUDA, Apple Metal / MPS / MLX, ROCm, Vulkan, and DirectML—never WSL2, Hyper-V, or Docker Desktop.

🛡️

OS-Level Kernel Sandbox

Default-deny process isolation enforced by Windows AppContainer + Job Objects, macOS Seatbelt (deny default), and Linux unprivileged Bubblewrap namespaces + Landlock LSM. Workers have zero direct host network stack.

🧹

Zero System Pollution

Installs and runs strictly in user space without admin/root privileges, global PATH mutations, Windows HKLM registry writes, or host Python interpreter coupling. Content-addressable deduplication uses hardlinks and APFS CoW clones.

🔐

Binary Zero-Copy IPC

Out-of-Band jetpack://pair approval, X25519 + Ed25519 handshake, and ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted hybrid framing ([4B len] + [MsgPack Header] + [Raw Payload]) deliver zero-copy buffers from WASM to workers.
